simplesect.para: In XSCT/classic flow, the device configuration is looked up based on DeviceId. The function calls other functions which contain loops that may be infinite if interrupts are not working such that it may not return. If the device slave select is not correct and the device is not responding on bus it reads a status of 0xFF for the status register as the bus is pulled up.

briefdescription.para: Runs the QSPI Flash interrupt example.
Implements a design example using the QSPI driver (XQspiPs) in interrupt mode with a serial FLASH device.

detaileddescription.para: The example performs some transfers in Manual Chip Select and Start mode. It is recommended to use Manual CS + Auto start for best performance. The hardware which this example runs on, must have a serial FLASH (Numonyx N25Q, Winbond W25Q, Spansion S25FL, ISSI IS25WP) for it to run. The example has been tested with the Numonyx Serial Flash (N25Q128) and IS25WP series flash parts.
